title: VOIDBREAKER
summary: A neon arena shooter with three weapons and escalating enemy waves.
description: Built by stealth/union-alpha through OpenRouter using OMP, including its weapon and arena subagents. Features rifle red-dot ADS, a shotgun, a marksman rifle with 4× scope, recoil, weapon inertia, physical cover, bloom and synthesized audio. Original generated game code; Three.js loads from a CDN.
